documentation.content:
An inventory queue task ran out of attempts: sold units weren't confirmed in their source, or reserved stock wasn't released. Stock in that source is off until the task is retried.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Qu%C3%A9-hacer-con-una-tarea-FAILED).

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (jsonPayload.message="Sold units not confirmed in their source" OR jsonPayload.message="Reserved stock not released")
